instruction: I need to build a presentation using images pic1.png, pic3.png, and pic5.png which are located on the Desktop. Create a presentation with three blank slides without any text or placeholder content, then add pic1.png to the first slide, pic3.png to the second slide, and pic5.png to the third slide, following this specific sequence.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires creating 3 blank slides and inserting odd-numbered images (pic1, pic3, pic5). Expected: 3 slides total, each with exactly 1 image. Similar complexity to original but with a subset of images.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator cannot verify WHICH images are on each slide (pic1.png, pic3.png, pic5.png). Only checks that each slide has 1 image, but doesn't verify the specific images or their sequence.
Instruction explicitly requires 'following this specific sequence' (pic1 on slide 1, pic3 on slide 2, pic5 on slide 3), but evaluator cannot distinguish between different images.
Evaluator cannot verify the 'blank slides without any text or placeholder content' requirement. Only counts images but doesn't check for text or placeholder presence.
Agent could add ANY 3 images (even the same image 3 times, or wrong images in wrong order) and still receive full score.
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Getter should extract image filenames or paths from each slide (using shape.image or image part relationships in python-pptx) to identify which specific images are present.
Metric should verify that slide 1 contains 'pic1.png', slide 2 contains 'pic3.png', and slide 3 contains 'pic5.png' by checking image filenames/paths.
Getter should check for text frames and placeholder content on each slide to verify 'blank slides' requirement.

Expected should specify which image file should be on which slide, not just counts: e.g., {'slide_count': 3, 'slide_images': [['pic1.png'], ['pic3.png'], ['pic5.png']], 'has_text': [False, False, False]}.
